messages:
jordyn: quick Q — designing the 'slim route views' save flow. If someone saves a compact per-route view, do we auto-propagate clones to compatible models or keep them strictly route-scoped? thinking about quota implications + telemetry. cc @anne @matt :thinking_face:

anne: my preference = independent by default. offer an explicit 'propagate to models' opt-in so we don't surprise teams or blow quotas. :+1:

matt: strongly agree on opt-in. auto-propagate will explode view counts and confuse ownership. also backend load spike risk.

sasha: telemetry angle: whatever we do, save payload must include sampling_hint and origin_tag so cost previews and regressions are traceable. Right now savedviews lose sampling metadata.

jordyn: noted. initial proposal for save payload (MVP):
```json
{
  "name": "Frontend errors — compact",
  "scope": "route",        // route | model
  "propagate": false,       // whether to clone to compatible models
  "sampling_hint": 0.05,    // approximate sample rate used for previews/telemetry
  "filters": { ... }
}
```

kevin: question: can we extend the existing /api/v1/savedviews contract? Current clients send {name, filters, scope}. If we add optional fields it should be backwards compatible, but we ought to version the contract in the API docs to be safe.

matt: backend caution: if propagate=true, do the cloning asynchronously. Sync clones will add latency and increase chance of timeouts for the save call. queue a background job and return 202 with a small banner UX.

anne: UX suggestion: on save with propagate checked, show 'We will create N model views — these are private to you by default. [Manage model views]' and surface a link to the job status.

jordyn: permission question: when we clone, do cloned model views inherit route-sharing ACLs or remain private? My vote: private by default, with an explicit 'share with route team' toggle in the clone job step.

kevin: telemetry events we should add:
- saveview_created {user_id, route_id, scope, propagate, sampling_hint}
- saveview_propagation {save_id, models_attempted, models_created, user_id}
- saveview_propagation_failed {save_id, model_id, reason}
Make fields required strings/numbers so downstream ingestion is simple.

sasha: add pre_save_cost_estimate and post_propagation_cost_estimate to telemetry. We need to alert if propagation would increase monthly token cost by > X%.

matt: edge case: compatible model set size = 0. UX should surface 'No compatible models found' and still persist the route-scoped view.

jordyn: billing attribution: if clones are created, costs should still be billed to original route/client to avoid double-charging. Proposal: include header X-Save-Origin: <save_id> during evaluation queries so usage attribution can join back.

kevin: we can add that header in the propagation worker. Also add a guard when models_count > 50 to require manual approval (or limit clones).

anne: docs: I'll add a 'propagation' section to saved-views API docs and include a sample payload + UX screenshots.

matt: devops: add rate-limit guard on propagation worker queue and a circuit breaker if clone success rate drops <80% in 10m.

jordyn: quick plan / ownership (MVP):
- API optional fields + minor version note (kevin)
- Propagation worker + rate guard + header (matt)
- UI checkbox + success banner + 'no compatible models' message (sasha)
- Telemetry events + cost estimates (kevin + sasha)
- Docs + sample payload (anne)
ETA: 2 weeks for a safe MVP to staging.

anne: I'll draft the docs + example payloads today and post link.

matt: I'll add unit tests for cloning logic and a migration test simulating 1000 saves.

jordyn: small UX nit: for the checkbox label use 'Clone to compatible models (creates private model views)'. keep it explicit.

kevin: devex-bot reports: deploy queued — feature/saves/propagate to staging at 2024-03-12T18:32:10Z.

jordyn: OK if no objections I'll put together a short RFC and kick off tasks. anything we missed?

sasha: one more: ensure saveview_id surfaces in console share links so we can quickly map telemetry -> saveview in the console.

matt: also add an admin metric: propagated_views_per_hour for capacity planning.

jordyn: great. thanks all. I'll open RFC and link PRs as they land. :rocket:
